description: Normalizes SteamSpy's per-app tag:votes dict (already present in the bulk payload, per the confirmed resolution that a separate steamspy_appdetails fetch is not used) into (appid, tag, votes, rank) rows for game_tags.
signature: def extract_tags(bundle: RawBundle, *, max_tags_per_game: int, min_votes: int) -> list[TagRow]
docstring:
Extract tag rows from bundle.steamspy's 'tags' field.

Args:
    bundle: Output of parse_raw_bundle.
    max_tags_per_game: Cap on tags retained per app, keeping only the top-voted max_tags_per_game tags.
    min_votes: Tags with votes below this are dropped entirely (not just deprioritized) -- this is a pre-clustering vote floor, distinct from AnalysisParams.min_tag_votes which is applied again inside analysis.cluster_tags for its own purposes; here it primarily controls game_tags table size.

Returns:
    A list of TagRow(appid, tag, votes, rank), rank being the tag's 1-based position within that app's tags after sorting by votes descending (ties broken alphabetically by tag name for determinism).

Note:
    SteamSpy's 'tags' field is sometimes a dict {tag: votes} and sometimes (for apps with very little data) an empty list []; both are handled uniformly, the list case producing zero TagRow entries for that appid.
postconditions: No appid contributes more than max_tags_per_game TagRow entries
Within one appid's tags, rank values are unique and contiguous starting at 1

edge_cases.input: tags field is an empty list []
edge_cases.expected_behavior: zero TagRow entries for that appid, not an error

edge_cases.input: tags field is a dict with a tag having votes=0
edge_cases.expected_behavior: dropped if min_votes > 0; kept with rank assigned if min_votes == 0

edge_cases.input: Two tags tie on vote count
edge_cases.expected_behavior: ranked by alphabetical tag name as the deterministic tiebreak

edge_cases.input: An appid absent from bundle.steamspy entirely (should not happen per RawBundle's postcondition)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: not iterated; extract_tags only processes appids present in bundle.steamspy

unit_tests.name: test_extract_tags_respects_max_per_game
unit_tests.description: An app with 20 tags and max_tags_per_game=10 yields exactly the top 10 by votes.
unit_tests.expected: 10 TagRow entries for that appid, ranks 1-10

unit_tests.name: test_extract_tags_drops_below_min_votes
unit_tests.description: A tag with votes=2 and min_votes=5 is excluded.
unit_tests.expected: that tag absent from the result

unit_tests.name: test_extract_tags_empty_list_input
unit_tests.description: An appid with tags=[] produces zero rows.

unit_tests.name: test_extract_tags_tie_break_alphabetical
unit_tests.description: Two tags with equal votes are ranked alphabetically.
unit_tests.expected: the alphabetically earlier tag has the lower rank number
